column5: REBUILT 2026-08-04 (Casey: "change chicken to figma for the lanes, we make the final call on odds"). SUPERSEDES the 2026-07-29 "backend wins" call. Rail is now the FIGMA model: 20 lanes, 1/3/5/7 hazards drawn WITHOUT replacement (hypergeometric), M_k = floor(9800 * C(20,k)/C(20-H,k)) at a single 2% edge applied once to the whole ladder. Reproduces all 51 published Figma multipliers exactly (easy 1.03x->19.60x over 19 rungs, medium 1.15x->1117.20x over 17); optimal-play RTP is exactly 0.98000000 on all four difficulties. The edge CANNOT be raised to the 5% the rest of the casino uses: rung 1 pays (1-edge)*L/(L-H), so at 1 hazard in 20 a 5% edge prices easy's first lane at exactly 1.0000x. Board is admin-tunable (site_config gaming_chicken_lanes / _hazards_<difficulty> / _house_edge_bps) and FROZEN into each round at start so an admin edit cannot reprice a crossing in progress. Client rebuilt as ChickenRoad (chicken/ChickenRoad.tsx): one lane per RUNG as Figma draws, only the next lane clickable. Two live bugs fixed: the reveal branched on result.isBone which the engine never sends (a bust rendered as SAFE), and cash out read result.multiplier/winAmount which it also never sends (the win and balance were client-computed and drifted above the server's floored payout). Both mappings are now pure functions in chicken/readChickenReveal.ts, tested against the real engine. PARTIAL only because CHICKEN_PLAYABLE=false pending one live staging round (cross/bust/cash out) - game logic is covered, the HTTP round trip is not. Daredevil has no Figma frames (kept at 7 hazards by decision).
